section_summary.extract_value: This section reports EFA and CFA results for the BAS in the current sample, noting two factors initially emerged but a unidimensional structure was supported after inspection of loadings and the scree plot. The single-factor CFA showed adequate fit (χ2 = 185.02, df = 65, CFI = .94, SRMR = .05, RMSEA = .09) and factor loadings ranged from .42 to .91, leading the authors to conclude the BAS is unidimensional in this sample of Black women.
section_summary.evidence_source: 'A preliminary EFA was conducted to explore BAS factor structure in the current sample, and two factors emerged with eigenvalues greater than 1... only one item loaded onto the second factor, indicating that a unidimensional factor was most appropriate; this was supported by a scree plot.' 'Next, a single CFA factor model was estimated... The model provided an adequate fit to the data (χ2 = 185.02, df = 65, CFI = .94, SRMR = .05, RMSEA = .09).' 'Thus, these results support the unidimensional nature of this measure among Black women.'
